title: Consequences of the fibre area identity: finiteness, integrability, signed and box identities
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 2) with weight μ := R.measure = θ·H²⌞M (H² = μHE[2]), Q a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π = Q.starProjection, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a,e⟩ = 0, and s ∈ ℝ. Put T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x with orthogonal projection p_{T_x}, Ax := ⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a, G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|² (real division, t/0 = 0), f(x) := arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,a⟩), F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)), Z(s,s') := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s', |x − πx| < s|x|} and Z := Z(s,s). Let H : ℝ² → [0,∞] be a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure with ∫ b(p)H(p) dp = ∫_Z b(F̃(x))·ofReal(G(x)) dμ(x) for every Borel b : ℝ² → [0,∞]. Then (i) H(p) < ∞ for a.e. p; (ii) H_ℝ := toReal∘H is Lebesgue integrable on ℝ²; (iii) for every Borel b : ℝ² → ℝ with sup|b| < ∞, ∫ b(p)H_ℝ(p) dp = ∫_Z b(F̃(x))G(x) dμ(x) (Bochner integrals); (iv) for every s' ≤ s, ∫_{(1−s',1+s')×(−s',s')} H(p) dp = ∫_{Z(s,s')} ofReal(G) dμ.
